info.title: Ignition Instance Admin API
info.description: Instance admin Bearer tokens only. Browser-only token management is separate. User creation follows current personal-team and authentication policy. Setup URLs are returned once; email delivery is external. Public resource IDs are runtime resource UUIDs. Prices are informational.

CreateResource.description: Choose exactly one provisioning mode: productId plus planId, or configuration without a product/plan. Both return 202 with resourceId and operationId. Manual resources have managed=false and no catalog assignment.

oneOf.description: Manual application, worker, database or function. Omitted CPU and memory use instance defaults. Image sources require image; Git sources require repoUrl. Functions use engine and code.
Manual game server. Game-specific settings and EULA acceptance are validated by the installed game adapter; omitted sizes follow its defaults.

details.description: Observed result metadata; deletion includes retainedVolumes and resourceSnapshot.

expiresAt.description: Null means the token never expires.

template.description: Template settings. Environment values and secret fields are redacted; send unchanged=true on existing keyed environment variables to preserve their values.

signingSecret.description: Shown only on creation; the original result is returned on an authorized idempotent replay.

post.description: Local onboarding requires role viewer/developer. SSO-only onboarding may omit role and uses ssoDefaultRole. personalTeams is read from the current Limits setting. createdTeam is null when disabled. No email is sent.
